edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the user whose dividends are withdrawn
msg.sender claims dividends through claim()
block.timestamp drives launch and trading gating logic in _transfer
_adjustTaxes selects tax periods using block.timestamp
processAccount stores block.timestamp as the last claim time
process uses block.timestamp for auto-claim eligibility checks
processDividendTracker emits tx.origin in ProcessedDividendTracker
_transfer emits tx.origin when processing dividends
_transfer calls _adjustTaxes to compute fees
_transfer invokes _swapAndLiquify which performs external ETH calls
_swapAndLiquify calls _swapTokensForEth
_swapAndLiquify calls _addLiquidity
_swapAndLiquify forwards ETH to marketingWallet via low-level call
_swapAndLiquify forwards ETH to foundationWallet via low-level call
_swapAndLiquify forwards ETH to devWallet via low-level call
_swapAndLiquify transfers holder tokens to the dividend tracker
_swapTokensForEth performs the Uniswap swap external call
_addLiquidity performs the Uniswap addLiquidityETH external call
claimEthOverflow sends the balance to owner via low-level call
_withdrawDividendOfUser transfers the reward token before finalizing state
user parameter flows into the dividend payout routine
account parameter is written into the holder balance mapping
newBalance parameter determines balance updates and holder set membership
gas parameter bounds the processing loop
from parameter is the source address of the transfer
to parameter is the destination address of the transfer
amount parameter is the transferred value subject to fees and limits
isBuyFromLp local drives buy tax selection in _transfer
isSelltoLp local drives sell tax selection in _transfer
currentTimestamp local is derived from block.timestamp for gating
fee local is derived by multiplying amount by _totalFee and dividing
burnAmount local is derived by multiplying amount by _burnFee
takeFee local controls whether fees are deducted in _transfer
withdrawable dividend local is the amount paid out to the user
amountEthMarketing local is the ETH value sent to marketingWallet
amountEthFoundation local is the ETH value sent to foundationWallet
amountEthDev local is the ETH value sent to devWallet

Gas parameter only exists to bound the dividend processing loop

Local buy-pair flag is a temporary within _transfer and can be folded into it
Local sell-pair flag is a temporary within _transfer and can be folded into it
Local timestamp is a temporary derived in _transfer for gating checks
Local fee value is a temporary computed during _transfer
Local burn value is a temporary computed during _transfer
Local takeFee flag is a temporary controlling fee application in _transfer
Local withdrawable value is a temporary inside the dividend payout routine
Local marketing ETH amount is computed solely for the marketing wallet call
Local foundation ETH amount is computed solely for the foundation wallet call
Local dev ETH amount is computed solely for the dev wallet call
